newsitem.title: GERMANY: Altana might be eying Nycomed-newsletter.
newsitem.headline: Altana might be eying Nycomed-newsletter.

text.p: German newsletter Platow Brief reported in its Thursday edition that German chemical and drugs group Altana AG might be interested in joining forces with Norwegian group Nycomed ASA.

The German newsletter reported cash-rich Altana was seriously looking for a partner to strengthen its pharmaceutical division and had cast an eye on Nycomed ASA, and offered this as explanation for Altana's recent share jump.
Altana was not immediately available for comment.
Altana shares had jumped noticably in recent days, fuelled by speculation that Altana itself might be a takeover target.

The company denied it was a takeover target and said the share price jump could have been triggered by the fact it expected to receive U.S. regulatory approval for one of its new respiratory products to be moved to the clinical testing phase.
Analysts however said expectations for approval to move to clinical testing could not be responsible for the share price rise.
Altana on Friday was down 30 marks at 1,680 marks.
